subject: Nebula Tech onboarding — purchase reference and spend cap clarification
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura@nebula-tech.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Nebula Tech onboarding — purchase reference and spend cap clarification

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for partnering with us — excited to get Nebula Tech set up. A couple of items to kick off procurement so we can get billing and access flowing: 

- I've attached our completed onboarding form (nebula_onboarding_form.pdf).
- We expect initial committed spend to be capped at $75,000/year for the Dedicated GPU pool + 10% buffer for overage approvals.
- Please confirm whether you prefer a single PO number for the subscription or separate POs per project line item. We prefer a single PO that includes cost-center and line-item breakdowns.

Could you also send over your vendor invoice template and the billing contact for AP so procurement can issue the PO correctly?

Thanks — I’ve cc’d Dev in procurement and Sean in finance to keep this moving.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: nebula_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF, 82KB)

From: Laura Chen <laura@nebula-tech.com>

Cc: contracts@nebula-tech.com
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2026 10:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nebula Tech onboarding — purchase reference and spend cap clarification

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the details — happy to get this moving. A few quick questions: 

- We can do a single PO with line-item breakdowns (preferred). Do you have a cost-center code we should reference?
- For the spend cap, is that a hard limit (drops service on breach) or an approval route for overages?

I've attached our invoice template so you can see the fields we require (vendor_invoice_template.xlsx). Our AP contact is Maria Lopez (maria.lopez@nebula-tech.com).

If you confirm cost-center and overage policy, we'll prep the contract side and provide a purchase reference number space for you.

Best,
Laura Chen
Head of Partnerships, Nebula Tech
laura@nebula-tech.com

Jasmine

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nebula Tech onboarding — purchase reference and spend cap clarification

Jasmine/Dev,

Confirming finance stance: use a single PO that lists line items and monthly rates. The $75,000/year is a soft spend cap tied to an approval workflow — we will not cut service immediately on breach, but AP will flag for review and route to the vendor manager for pre-approved overages up to 10%. Please include the following on the PO: 

- Cost center: CC-ENG-42
- Spend cap code: SC-RED-2026-07
- Billing contact: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@nebula-tech.com>

I've filled the PO template with the suggested line-item breakdown (attached PO_template_filled.pdf). Procurement should issue the PO number (format PR-YYYY-####). When issuing, make sure unit descriptions match the invoice template that Laura sent.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com

Attachment: PO_template_filled.pdf (PDF, 46KB)

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura@nebula-tech.com>, contracts@nebula-tech.com
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Issued PO PR-2026-4587 — Nebula Tech (line item corrections and spend cap)

Hi Laura / Contracts team,

Thanks for the patience — procurement has issued the purchase reference for your onboarding: PR-2026-4587. Summary and required actions below: 

- PO number: PR-2026-4587 (please reference on all invoices).
- Cost center: CC-ENG-42 (include on invoice header).
- Spend cap: SC-RED-2026-07 — $75,000/year with a 10% pre-approved buffer for urgent overages. Any overrun beyond buffer will require approval via HubSpot procurement ticket (https://redwood.hubspot.com/ticket/PROC-4219).
- Line items (as agreed / corrected to match your invoice template):
  1) Dedicated GPU pool — Monthly metered — unit: GPU-hour — unit price: $1.25/GPU-hour
  2) Support / On-call premium — Monthly flat — unit: month — unit price: $2,500/month
  3) One-time onboarding services (optional) — unit: lump sum — unit price: $3,000

Attached is the signed PO (signed_PO_PR-2026-4587.pdf). Please countersign or acknowledge receipt and confirm the billing start date. If the invoice format requires any additional columns, let us know and we'll adjust.

Next steps for you: countersign the PO (or reply with a signed PDF) and send the first invoice referencing PR-2026-4587 and cost center CC-ENG-42. Once we receive the signed acknowledgment we'll kick off onboarding access.

Best regards,
Dev Patel
Procurement Specialist, Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.com

Attachment: signed_PO_PR-2026-4587.pdf (PDF, 104KB)
